source: Matching per-outer/seed T2_COUPLED_V1 checkpoint, INNER-selected only
scope: All 52 deterministic one-click episodes / eight F1 TRAIN scenes, every future frame, no outer method selection
capacity_controls: Same K8-trained weights; changing deployment bank capacity is explicitly an inference state-shift diagnostic
uniform_attention_control: Uniform candidate-independent attention; remaining max/mean bank statistics are retained, not falsely claimed removal of every selection operation
only_bank_control: Remove anchor-score/anchor-consistency features from identity scoring once machine bank exists, sole human anchor is initial fallback bank, P1 writes without anchor gating
without_availability_control: Nonempty candidate set forces a candidate; structural empty set still NONE. Availability is constant for decisions/write inputs, not silently retained as a learned reject gate
no_cross_session_training: All actual T2 models lack such supervision. No fake separately cross-session-trained comparison is created
success_claim: Inference deletion differences alone cannot establish independently learned module benefit; report training/deployment distribution shift and unsupported cross-recording conclusions
